provenance: Synthetic mortgage-underwriting corpus authored for Story 24.6 live retrieval measurement. No real borrower, applicant, or customer data. No PII. Every document is fabricated and tenant-scoped to allura-system / workspace-allura.
domain: Residential mortgage origination and underwriting review — the domain of the Mortgage Approval Gate module and the Northstar Lending demo tenant.

retrieval.method: PostgreSQL full-text search over the generated content_tsv column, ranked by ts_rank_cd
retrieval.note: Lexical retrieval only. The hybrid vector path is NOT exercised because no embedding service runs in this environment; see DEMO-EVIDENCE-PACK.md open items. A lexical-only score is reported honestly rather than presented as hybrid quality.

design_note: The corpus deliberately contains topical distractors that share vocabulary with the queries — several documents mention 'ratio', 'verification', 'insurance', 'disclosure', and 'timing'. Without distractors, P@5 over a corpus smaller than k is trivially 1.0 and measures nothing.

documents.content: Debt-to-income ratio exceeded the guideline ceiling at 47 percent back-end against a 43 percent maximum; underwriter documented compensating factors of twelve months reserves and a 780 representative credit score.
Loan-to-value ratio calculated at 91 percent against the appraised value, above the 80 percent threshold, which triggers the private mortgage insurance requirement.
Reserve requirement for a second home is two months of principal, interest, taxes and insurance, evidenced by seasoned depository statements.
Self-employed income verification requires two years of filed returns with the profit and loss statement, averaged, and declining income must be addressed in writing by the underwriter.
Wage earner income verification uses the most recent pay stubs, the prior year W-2, and a verbal verification of employment completed within ten days of closing.
Flood zone determination returned zone AE, a special flood hazard area, so flood insurance is mandatory for the life of the loan with coverage at least equal to the outstanding principal.
Title insurance commitment lists an unreleased prior lien in Schedule B-I that must be cleared before the policy can issue without exception.
Private mortgage insurance terminates automatically at 78 percent loan-to-value based on the original amortization schedule, or earlier on borrower request at 80 percent.
Escrow account analysis projects a shortage after the county reassessment; the servicer must offer a spread of the shortage over twelve monthly installments.
Adverse action notice must be delivered within thirty days of receiving a completed application, stating the specific principal reasons for denial and the credit bureau relied upon.

Closing disclosure timing requires the borrower to receive the disclosure at least three business days before consummation; a changed annual percentage rate outside tolerance restarts the waiting period.
Appraisal came in below the contract price, creating a valuation gap; the file requires either a renegotiated price, additional borrower funds, or a reconsideration of value with comparable sales.
Condominium project approval requires warrantability review covering owner-occupancy ratio, single-entity ownership concentration, budget reserve allocation, and pending litigation.
Home Mortgage Disclosure Act reporting fields must capture the loan purpose, action taken, and applicant demographic information collected under the required collection method.
Fair lending review under the Equal Credit Opportunity Act examines whether underwriting exceptions were granted consistently across protected classes within the same product and period.
Underwriting exception log records each guideline variance, the approving authority level, and the documented compensating factors supporting the decision.
Rate lock extension policy charges a fee per additional fifteen day period, and the extension must be requested before the original expiration date.
Occupancy misrepresentation red flags include a subject property far from the stated employer with no relocation documentation in the file.
Qualified mortgage points and fees test caps total points and fees at three percent of the loan amount for loans at or above the applicable threshold.
Loss mitigation review requires a complete borrower package before a foreclosure referral may proceed, and dual tracking is prohibited once the package is complete.

queries.query: debt to income ratio exceeded guideline compensating factors
self employed income verification two years returns
adverse action notice thirty days denial reasons
closing disclosure three business days before consummation
